note: Declarative provider templates (data rows with placeholders) plus built-in presets; no executable plugin
Template fields (wireApi, authMethod, requiredEnvs, docsUrl); no capability or version table
Remote template registry on a GitHub branch via contents API and raw URLs, merged with built-ins, 1 hour cache
No hash or signature check found in templates.ts by string search; mutable main branch
No permission or isolation; a remote TOML fragment is written into the Codex config
No upgrade or rollback of templates beyond cache expiry
requiredEnvs lists environment variables a template needs; no inter-template dependencies
No compatibility field; scope list names the client (codex)
